ORDINANCE XI OF 2001
WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the West Pakistan Cotton Control
Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 18th July,
2001]
No.Legis. 13-XI/2001, dated
18-7-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the West Pakistan Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 17 of the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance 1966

ORDINANCE XI OF 2001
WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the West Pakistan Cotton Control
Ordinance, 1966
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 18th July,
2001]
No.Legis. 13-XI/2001, dated
18-7-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab
is hereby published for general information:---
2. Substitution of section 17 of the West Pakistan Cotton Control
Ordinance 1966.--For section 17 of the West Pakistan Cotton Control
Ordinance, 1966 the following shall be substituted:
"Section
17. Punishment for admixture, adulteration, contamination and watering cotton.--(1)
Any occupier of a factory or any other person--
(a) who handles
or facilitates handling cotton in any cloth made of other than cotton fiber
uses twines made of any fiber other than cotton, waters seed cotton or lint
beyond specified limits (more than 10%) allows any foreign substance i.e., jute
fiber,. jute twines, polypropylene bags, human/animal hair, confectionery wrappers
etc., gins or presses or allows such cotton to be ginned or pressed in such
factory; or
(b) who, in any
area specified in the notification under section 16, gins or presses or allows
to be ginned or pressed any cotton which he knows or has reasons to believe to
contain an admixture of different varieties of cotton;
shall be punishable with
imprisonment which may extend to six months and with tine which shall not be
less than fifteen thousand rupees.
(2) Any owner of
cotton who knowingly waters or causes to be watered any cotton to be ginned, or
which being already ginned and is intended to be pressed in a factory or mixes
or causes to be mixed other varieties, seed foreign substance or cotton waste
with such cotton, or who abets or knowingly allows or connives at any such act,
shall be punishable with imprisonment which may extend to six months and with
fine which may extend to fifteen thousand rupees.
Explanation.--For the purposes of
this section cotton shall not be deemed to be watered unless such cotton
contains moisture in excess of the normal quantity (not more than l0% ), that
is to say, the amount of moisture that any given quantity of cotton is
reasonably expected to have, regard being had to the place or places and the
time or times of the year in which such cotton has been picked, collected,
stored, conveyed, left, ginned or pressed.
Note: For the words "West Pakistan" where occurring please
read "Punjab" vide Corrigendum issued in Extraordinary Gazette of
Punjab dated 22-8-2001 p.1553.
